name: Murder Drones: RP | REMASTERED
desc:
Just like any other roleplay game, you have a map, some morphs, and a sprinkle of customization.

There is no other developer other than the owner.

Murder Drones is a computer-animated science fiction comedy-horror web series created by Liam Vickers and produced by Glitch Productions and funded by Screen Australia for GLITCH
